title.label: Well-made app with excellent and responsive developer

content.label: Been using this app to track a number of habits, and it’s very well made. The developer is very responsive and is really great with feedback. Highly recommended.
I love the app! The UI is great, and the app is easy to use.

I absolutely love HabitKit! It is by far the best habit tracking app I have ever used. The tile-based grid charts make it super easy to visualize my progress, and the customization options for the dashboard are a great touch. The ability to choose my own colors, icons, and descriptions really helps me to personalize the app to my own needs and goals.

One of the things I love most about HabitKit is the motivation it provides. Seeing the tiles on my dashboard fill up with color as I complete my habits is a great way to stay motivated and on track. The app is also very user-friendly and easy to navigate. I highly recommend HabitKit to anyone looking to form new habits or break old ones.

Overall, I would give HabitKit a solid 5 out of 5 stars. It has truly made a difference in my life and I am so grateful to have found it. Thank you, Sebastian, for creating such a wonderful app!

This app is perfect. I really want to start reading, work out more regularly and drink water.. just being more healthy or conscious how I spend my day. And this really helps my forgetful mind to keep track of what I’ve done but also what I still need to do :D
Huge fan of the clean interface and functionality of this app!

I’ve been looking for a solution to help keep track of my workouts, reading, and alcohol consumption. Specifically, I wanted a solution that would let me visualize my progress in those areas. HabitKit nails the visualization for me. 

The maker of HabitKit is also quick to respond to questions and suggestions, which is a great sign of what’s to come with this solution.

The app is beautifully made and approachable. My suggestions are reminders that keep bugging you until you complete something. Also it would be nice to have habits that can reoccur multiple times per day. For example 4 sets of 25 push-ups per day

I search everywhere apps, most of them aren’t what I want because too advanced. This app is very simply and made me motivated want use this app everyday, this is exactly what I’m looking for. Keep it up!

HabitKit is an exciting app. It's gorgeous to see, it's a joy to use, it may well be best in class. Also: The developer is friendly and responsive to feature requests... HabitKit has arrived just in time for the new year; I expect to use the app each- and every day... I'm happy to see that it's buyable (subscription not required!) and right now, priced at just 15 bucks, it's well worth it too... Give this app a try -- it's great already and it'll get only better!

I always wanted to see how my habits are formed like github activities and found no apps than habitKit. This is the best app for tracking any kind of habits. Very simple and clean! Thanks for creating such a great app
